svg.title: White Bar with Blue and Red
svg.desc: Interpretive hand-authored study after visual inspection of the1996 Guggenheim retrospective plate. Approximate geometry; interpretive palette. Texture, mounting shadows and perspective omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for red, blue, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://archive.org/download/ellswo00kell/ellswo00kell.pdf#page=187; catalogue 65; visually inspected2026-10-27. Interpretive study, not facsimile.
